products.name: HSK cloze sentence deck
products.tagline: One HSK word blanked per sentence — multiple choice, typing, or reveal.

products.description: A Clozemaster-shaped deck built from the graded sentence corpus. Each card is a sentence with one HSK word blanked out, answered by multiple choice, by typing it, or by revealing it — words met in context rather than on their own, with the whole sentence spoken.

Three answer modes on the same note: multiple choice, typing, reveal
Every sentence spoken
Its own note type and card design — imports beside the word decks without touching them
